{{Quote|Step back, boys. I show you how it's done.|Sixtat, boasting about his skills with a sniper rifle.|<ref name="TB" />|}}
'''Sixtat''', also known as the '''Outlands Butcher''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] in operation during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==

=== Early career ===
Native from<ref name="SWI132" /> the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> of [[Sakiya|Saki]],<ref name="SWI132"/> Sixtat was a [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]], a species well-suited for hunting big game, thanks to their keen senses and quick reflexes. His grim talent for slaying his targets in a gruesome manner earned him the colorful<ref name="SWE"/> title of the Outlands Butcher.<ref name="TB" /> He translated such talents into bounty hunting, gaining him much notoriety<ref name="SWE" /> as well as the arrogance to believe he was unstoppable.<ref name="TB" />

=== The Box ===
Eventually, his success as a bounty hunter caught the attention of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] who wanted him to compete with other bounty hunters in the [[Box/Legends|Box]], a death machine designed by [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] to win the honor of kidnapping [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="TB" /> Dooku recruited the best bounty hunters he could find and wanted to ensure only the most skillful, cunning and deadly hired guns survived.<ref name="SWE" /> On [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] Sixtat witnessed [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] murder another bounty hunter [[Bulduga/Legends|Bulduga]] to get his hat. Soon, Dooku briefed everyone on the challenge the bounty hunters had to face including telling them about The Box. They were all deprived of their weapons and soon they entered The Box.<ref name="TB" />

Their first challenge was to escape a room that was filling with [[Dioxis/Legends|dioxis]] gas. Platforms began to rise from the ground and all the bounty hunters, Sixtat being one of the first climbed on top of them. Seconds later, he was kicked off the platform by [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], though he got on top of another one. Another bounty hunter, [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], who was actually [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] in disguise, found a secret tunnel underneath the ground. Sixtat was doubtful of discovery but nevertheless followed him through the tunnel along with the other hunters, thus surviving the first round.<ref name="TB" />

In the second round, ledges began to slide out of the walls with a sword resembling a lightsaber swinging around on its front. Bulduga's brother [[Onca/Legends|Onca]] quickly fell prey to the blades. As before, Hardeen saw an open tunnel on the ceiling. Using the ledges, he and Bane hopped to the top towards the tunnel with the other bounty hunters following behind. Sixtat got out of the challenge along with the remaining bounty hunters.<ref name="TB" />

The third challenge involved the whole room being ray-shielded and the walls closing in. The switch to deactivate the shields was located in shaft in the wall behind a smaller ray-shield. Eval provided a special serum that, if injected can provide the person temporary immunity to the ray-shields. Platforms began to rise out of the center of the ground. A hunter called [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]] was able to inject the serum due to his anatomy of being immune to such serums. Derrown was eventually able to press the button and the surviving hunters made it to the next and final round.<ref name="TB" />

=== Death ===
[[File:SixtatTakesAim-TB.jpg|thumb|left|270x270px|Sixtat in the final round]]
They found themselves on a platform with the ground below them doused in flames. This challenge involved sharpshooting which Sixtat preferred. A small yellow target zipped across the wall. Next to them, a sniper rifle appeared in a small machine. Sixtat took the rifle and aimed at the target. He shot the first two perfectly but missed the third. As a result, the platform he stood on disappeared into the ground and Sixtat fell into the flames which killed him.<ref name="TB" />

== Behind the scenes ==
Sixtat was created for the TV series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', and appeared in the episode "[[The Box]]," where his voice was provided by [[Corey Burton]].<ref name="TB" /> Sixtat's model was a customization of a [[Vadoo/Legends|pre-existing character]] from "[[Padawan Lost]]".<ref>{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep417|text="The Box" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
